messages.subject: Stan Error
parts:
Hello Stan People,
 I am trying to run the dog Bug example as per the translation into stan given here:https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/wiki/BUGS-Examples-Sorted-by-Volume
Apparently something seems to be wrong as I keep on getting this error:



successful in parsing the Stan model '53ecd981fc5dacc5378b1f3262941a38'.

CHECKING DATA AND PREPROCESSING FOR MODEL '53ecd981fc5dacc5378b1f3262941a38' NOW.

COMPILING MODEL '53ecd981fc5dacc5378b1f3262941a38' NOW.

STARTING SAMPLER FOR MODEL '53ecd981fc5dacc5378b1f3262941a38' NOW.

SAMPLING FOR MODEL '53ecd981fc5dacc5378b1f3262941a38' NOW (CHAIN 1).
[1] "inf"                                                                                                                                   
[2] "Informational Message: The current Metropolis proposal is about to be rejected because of the following issue:"                        
[3] "Exception thrown at line 36: stan::math::bernoulli_log: Probability parameter is inf, but must be finite!"                             
[4] "If this warning occurs sporadically, such as for highly constrained variable types like covariance matrices, then the sampler is fine,"
[5] "but if this warning occurs often then your model may be either severely ill-conditioned or misspecified."                              
[6] "Rejecting initial value:"                                                                                                              
[7] "  Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value."                                                                          
[8] "Error : "                                                                                                                              
[1] "error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done"

Please help me figure out what could be wrong.
